project_info.theme: Holographic Y2K scrapbook poster with repeated adult portrait cutouts
project_info.creative_direction: Pastel magazine collage with holographic paper, sticker graphics, and varied fashion interactions
project_info.color_palette: lavender, pink, pale blue, cream, mint, holographic silver, white, and neon pink outlines

main_subject.detail: same approved adult woman in every cutout, dark brown half-up hair with pink-tinted lower strands, pastel flower clips, warm natural smile, and consistent face
main_subject.wardrobe: pastel cropped oversized sweater with embroidered patches, pastel skirt and white belt, pastel-striped ankle socks, white sneakers, colorful bracelets, chunky rings, and decorative waist chain
main_subject.poses: heart fingers, central confident standing pose with lens-flare keychain, crouched camera pose, bubblegum portrait, cat portrait, winking peace sign, and daisy bouquet

composition_elements.framing: vertical frameless collage with a large central portrait and surrounding Polaroid-like cutouts
composition_elements.graphics: holographic paper, pastel gradients, glitter accents, hearts, stars, butterflies, neon outlines, doodle borders, and fictional magazine text SO CUTE!, 199X!, and GIRL VIBES
composition_elements.balance: chaotic but balanced arrangement with clear subject hierarchy and readable negative space

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft direct flash at approximately 5200K with colorful pastel bounce
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: dreamy glossy glow, clean skin detail, controlled sparkle, and consistent cutout edges

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame 35mm fashion snapshots combined with holographic scrapbook compositing
technical_specs.finish: photoreal adult portraits, stable hands and anatomy, vivid pastel color, subtle texture, and crisp sticker graphics

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a colorful holographic Y2K scrapbook poster featuring the same clearly adult woman in multiple cutout portraits, all wearing the same pastel outfit and hairstyle. Give her dark brown half-up hair with pink-tinted lower strands, pastel flower clips, consistent face, and a warm natural smile. Dress her in a pastel cropped oversized sweater with embroidered patches, pastel skirt with white belt, pastel-striped ankle socks, white sneakers, colorful bracelets, chunky rings, and a decorative waist chain. Include heart-finger close-up, central confident standing pose holding a lens-flare keychain, crouched pose with a white instant camera, cheek-touching bubblegum portrait, elegant cat portrait, winking peace sign, and daisy bouquet pose. Use holographic textures, pastel gradients, glitter accents, hearts, stars, butterflies, neon outlines, doodle borders, Polaroid frames, and fictional magazine text such as SO CUTE!, 199X!, and GIRL VIBES. Use soft approximately 5200K flash, a glossy dreamy retro glow, photoreal adult portraits, and stable anatomy. Keep all poses playful, non-sexual, and clearly adult.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, childlike styling, suggestive pout, real logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed limbs, face mismatch, broken collage, illegible text
